about: R2-DECK-LAYOUT §D4, set in DL0 from the evaluator's measurement of the shipped grounded-bridge-v2 deck (renders/deck_layout/eval_before.json, design doc §Evidence). make deck-layout-eval fails on any miss. Where the shipped deck already met the design's bar, the bar stands; where the design asked for a number that had to be measured first, the measured value is a ratchet (boom intrusions, station spread, the spawn's sky fraction) or a target the layout must reach (the spawn's lift share, the Commons ceilings at 0).
